title: Head-first acceptance: accept a technique outright when the technique head is sure of it
parent: docs/preregistration/cribl_product_integration_2026-10-19.json (the head-aware pair, on by default since 2026-10-20); docs 21.3.18
question: With the head on, the pipeline sits at the head's own ceiling on exact ids but 2 to 6 points under it at the family level and on AthenaBench, because the calibrated gate sometimes holds the head's right answer back. Does accepting a candidate outright when the head's probability for it clears a bar, keeping the calibrated gate for everything else, close that gap without a precision cost that outweighs it?

change.rule: in _assign_states_for_group, a candidate whose technique_head evidence carries th_technique_p (P(family) x P(technique | family)) at or above the artifact's head_first_min_probability is accepted on that alone, with the reason recorded; the benign- and sparse-context guards, verifier verdicts, the reranker and the hierarchy rules apply as before, and observations the head did not score are unchanged
change.where_the_bar_comes_from: the acceptance artifact's gate record, chosen by the fit on public dev: scripts/fit_acceptance_model.py --head-first runs the out-of-fold runtime threshold rule (now head-first-aware) for bars {none, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95} jointly with the usual threshold grid and keeps the pair with the best out-of-fold micro-F1 at the precision floor; 'none' competes, so the fit may decline the rule. TECHNIQUE_HEAD_FIRST=model follows the artifact, off ignores it, a number forces a bar for an ablation
change.note: the 0.8 figure quoted in the discussion came from CTI-HAL rows and is not used; the bar is chosen on dev only

arms.head: the current default (the schema-4 head-aware pair; artifacts of the re-evaluation of 2026-10-20 reused)
arms.head_first: a schema-4 refit with --head-first on public dev, through the head-aware pair

headline: CTI-HAL accepted-set micro-F1, head_first minus head, paired case bootstrap (1,000, seed 7), lower bound above 0
constraints: public test pooled micro-F1 not below the head arm beyond its paired interval
parent-aware F1 not below the head arm on either set
CTI-HAL attribution top-1 not below the head arm and no wrong name; Elastic strict top-1 not below, no wrong name on the attributed posts, open-set names 0
secondary: the dev-chosen bar and threshold and the out-of-fold grid
how many acceptances the rule adds and how many of those are right, per set
AnnoCTR, CTI-Rationale, AthenaBench ATE, CTIBench ATE and CyberThreat-Eval head_first against head (report only)
selection: the bar and threshold on public dev only; one run per arm per set
adoption: if the headline and constraints hold, the head-first artifact becomes the ACCEPTANCE_MODEL_HEAD_PATH default; otherwise the current pair stays and the result is documented
cost: laptop only, about 1.5 hours; no API credit
